title: SOFT SELL
tagline: "Embrace Web3, Elevate Sales: SoftSell's Vision for Tomorrow's Decentralized Commerce."
description: The problem that we tried to solve is to empower individuals and organization to use the web3 based NFTs powered by SOFT SELL so that the Businesses can provide their services and products as offerings via NFT promotions. Each NFT issued on SOFT SELL comes with staked ERC 20 Tokens which provide an additional layer of advantage for the customer incase of Loosing NFT's. All the interactions happen on chain there by provide complete transparancy for all the parties involved. The goal is to move trust from the written paper to the a digital solutions which can enfore payments, transparancy and digital signatures.
how_its_made:
We ran into multiple challanges, 
Contract implementation: We implemented ERC20, NFT and a sale contract which work hand in hand to power up the platform. The core sale function ran into gas issues and the number of lines of code went beyond the blocksize limits of the celio blockchain on which we deployed out contracts. However we were able to solve majority of the problems. 
Fairly new beginners: Apart from one individual rest of the team is very new to coding and its quite challenging for the team to work collectively and build such a sophisticated solution
Integration isuues: While intergrating web3 with frontend is a challening task for us we ran in multiple issues which we have really tried our best to resolve and get the app to a functional state
Depricated dependencies: One of the npm pakages that used has gave us tough time as its sub dependency is depricated, it took significant time to get resolved
Some of the inginifant issues are realted to the mismatch in the technical expertise of the team members it took quite some time to build the code
